# pbs_s3_endpoint (Data Source)

Reads a specific S3 endpoint configuration from Proxmox Backup Server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the S3 endpoint.

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String, Sensitive) Access key for S3 object store.
- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint to access S3 object store.
- `fingerprint` (String) X509 certificate fingerprint (sha256).
- `path_style` (Boolean) Use path style bucket addressing over vhost style.
- `port` (Number) Port to access S3 object store.
- `provider_quirks` (Set of String) S3 provider-specific quirks. Example: `['skip-if-none-match-header']` for Backblaze B2 compatibility.
- `region` (String) Region to access S3 object store.
